marikina_2020.what_is_measured: 22.01 m peak river stage during Typhoon Ulysses/Vamco
marikina_2020.location: Sto. Niño gauge, left side of Marikina Bridge, Marikina City
marikina_2020.interpretation: PAGASA table reports the local maximum for this station. Street ponding may lag or persist after the river peak.

nagano_2019.what_is_measured: 12.46 m peak river stage, MLIT 10-minute observation
nagano_2019.location: Tategahana gauge, Chikuma River at Nakano, outside the Naganuma tile
nagano_2019.interpretation: The downstream river gauge gives a precise hydrologic reference. Water entering and leaving the breached Naganuma floodplain followed a different trajectory.

mabi_2018.what_is_measured: Observed Oda River stage crest shortly after 02:00 JST on 7 July, reported by investigator reading the local stage series
mabi_2018.location: Higashiminari gauge, Oda River, west of the selected Mabi tile
mabi_2018.interpretation: Exact minute is unspecified. Backwater on the lower Oda and drainage of the breached floodplain can shift the local flood maximum.

gatineau_2017.what_is_measured: Regulation board reports highest stage 45.13 m on 7 May; time unspecified
gatineau_2017.location: Gatineau (Hull), Ottawa River; nearby same-city gauge, separate from the Pointe-Gatineau tile
gatineau_2017.interpretation: Peak day refers to the Hull gauge. The Ottawa and Gatineau river confluence influences the selected neighborhood.

edgecumbe_2017.what_is_measured: Wall breach around 08:30 NZST 6 April at approximately 6.19 mRL; river flow near 670 cubic metres/second at failure
edgecumbe_2017.interpretation: The observed failure establishes flood onset. Floodplain maximum and timing were not measured by this observation.

hitoyoshi_2020.what_is_measured: Last recorded stage before gauge lost readings was 6.12 m at 08:30 JST on 4 July. A later high-water mark gives elevation without time.
hitoyoshi_2020.interpretation: The image is dated 4 July UTC but was acquired on 5 July locally. The last gauge reading cannot provide an exact stage-peak lag.

usf_weihui_1.what_is_measured: Briefing on 28 July reported maximum urban pooled-water volume 20 million cubic metres and about 16 million remaining; no exact day for that maximum
usf_weihui_1.location: Weihui urban area as described in the provincial briefing; no station or per-tile timestamp
usf_weihui_1.interpretation: All three tiles share one scene and incident. The report has no per-tile timing; two boxes are geographically distant from the town center.
